decisiveLogLines: PROOF-5D5 normalized report missing: Error: Cannot find module './e2e/globalSetup.ts'
[playwright] runtime cleanup failed: Camp01PlaywrightNormalizerError: CAMP01_PLAYWRIGHT_NORMALIZER_INVALID: raw report missing

expectedVsObserved.probeExpected: The launcher writes reports/05-layout-helpers.json under the staged artifact directory, exits 1 with signal null, report.complete===true, exactly one failed observation, no surviving .runtime-<executionId>, no partial publication.
expectedVsObserved.probeObserved: Playwright CLI aborted during config load, before any test ran and before any JSON reporter output existed. The normalizer then threw 'raw report missing'; the normalized report was never written; camp01-live-browser-adversarial.mjs:265 threw 'PROOF-5D5 normalized report missing: <stderr>'.

chain: 1. The probe (scripts/qc/camp01-live-browser-adversarial.mjs:260-264) synthesizes a throwaway Playwright config at <scratchRoot>/playwright.config.ts, where scratchRoot is an fs.mkdtemp() directory OUTSIDE the repository (scripts/qc/run-camp01-live-adversarial.mjs:237).

2. That synthetic config (failingPlaywrightConfig, scripts/qc/camp01-live-browser-adversarial.mjs:293-305) spreads the repo-root config object: `import baseConfig from '<repoRoot>/playwright.config.ts'; export default { ...baseConfig, testDir: <abs>, webServer: undefined, fullyParallel: false, retries: 0, workers: 1, projects: [{name:'chromium'}] }`.

3. The spread deliberately neutralizes every inherited key that is meaningless outside the repo/server context - testDir is overridden to an ABSOLUTE path, webServer is nulled - but the override list is a hand-maintained allowlist, not derived from the base config.

4. Commit 8486a98ec added `globalSetup: './e2e/globalSetup.ts'` to playwright.config.ts (line 83 at current main). It is a REPO-ROOT-RELATIVE string and is NOT in the probe's override list, so the spread copies it verbatim into the scratch config.

5. Playwright resolves script-valued config keys (globalSetup/globalTeardown) against the CONFIG FILE's own directory, not the process cwd. The launcher spawns the CLI with cwd=repoRoot (scripts/playwright/run-playwright.mjs:68), but the config lives in scratchRoot, so './e2e/globalSetup.ts' is looked up at <scratchRoot>/e2e/globalSetup.ts. The probe does create <scratchRoot>/e2e/ (as the synthetic testDir) but never places a globalSetup.ts in it -> MODULE_NOT_FOUND at config-load time, before any test executes.

6. With the CLI dead before the JSON reporter ran, camp01-playwright-normalizer.mjs:39 finds an empty raw directory and throws CAMP01_PLAYWRIGHT_NORMALIZER_INVALID: raw report missing; run-playwright.mjs:102-105 logs '[playwright] runtime cleanup failed' and exits 1; the probe's normalizedPath existence check (camp01-live-browser-adversarial.mjs:265) fails and the probe reports PROBE_FAILED.
7. The per-leg workflow step fails on the launcher exit code, both matrix legs go red, and live-tier-signal (scripts/qc/camp01-live-signal.mjs) reconciles both legs and fails the run.
mechanism.secondaryDefect: Even if the path resolved, the inherited globalSetup would be wrong for this probe. e2e/globalSetup.ts issues HTTP warm-up requests against the projects' baseURL, but the synthetic config sets `webServer: undefined` - no dev server is started. The warm-up would fail on connection refusal (or on 'no project declares a baseURL', since the synthetic config replaces `projects` with a bare `[{name:'chromium'}]`). globalSetup is server-dependent machinery and belongs in the same strip list as webServer regardless of path resolution.
mechanism.whyNotCaughtPreMerge: #1544 added src/__tests__/unit/e2eHarness/warmupDeclaration.test.ts, which holds the WARM-UP ROUTE DECLARATION against reality. Nothing holds the probe's synthetic-config OVERRIDE LIST against playwright.config.ts. There is no jest suite for scripts/qc/camp01-live-browser-adversarial.mjs at all (scripts/__tests__/ has 20+ camp01-*.test.ts files; no camp01-live-browser-adversarial.test.ts). The workflow has no pull_request trigger, so #1544 could not have gone red before merge.
notTheCause: Not a Playwright or Node version bump: run 33645521430 and run 34936659219 both report Node v22.23.2 and Chromium 143.0.7499.4, and the failure text is byte-identical; the last green run is 9 minutes before the first red one on the same runner images.
Not a moved spec path: the probe writes its own deliberately-failing spec into scratchRoot at run time.
Not an environment-variable rename: the other 7 probes pass and the 3 skips are all disposition 'expected'.
Not the frozen argv or the camp-01h contract: the probe's launcher argv is constructed ad hoc and is absent from camp01-authority-receipt.contract.mjs commandSequence rows.

rootCause.confidence: high - single-commit range, mechanism named in the log text, identical on all four legs across 13 days
rootCause.statement: Commit 8486a98ec (#1544) introduced `globalSetup: './e2e/globalSetup.ts'` into playwright.config.ts. The proof5d5-playwright-failure-traversal probe re-homes that config into an out-of-repo temp directory by spreading it, and its hand-maintained override list does not neutralize globalSetup, so Playwright resolves the repo-root-relative path against the temp directory and aborts at config load with MODULE_NOT_FOUND.

proposedFix.shape: Close the class, not just the instance: make the probe's synthetic config neutralize every inherited key whose value is a repo-root-relative script path, and add the missing jest guard that holds the override list against the real playwright.config.ts.

changes.edit: Add `globalSetup: undefined,` (and `globalTeardown: undefined,` as the symmetric neutralizer - the base config has no globalTeardown today, and adding it pre-empts the identical break) to the generated config literal, with a one-line comment stating WHY: the config is re-homed into an out-of-repo scratch directory, so every repo-root-relative script path the base declares must be dropped, and globalSetup is server-dependent machinery that has no server here because webServer is undefined.
Export failingPlaywrightConfig so the guard can assert against it (currently module-private; the file already exports PROOF5D5_LIVE_PROBE_REGISTRATIONS at line 42).

changes.site: new suite; scripts/__tests__/ is the established home for 20+ camp01-*.test.ts files
changes.edit: Declaration-held-against-reality guard, the same pattern #1544 itself used for warm-up routes. Read playwright.config.ts source, extract every top-level config key whose value is a relative path string literal (matching /^'\.\.?\//), and assert failingPlaywrightConfig(base, testDir) emits an explicit override for each. Plus behavioural rows: (a) the generated config text contains `globalSetup: undefined`; (b) a row that adds a synthetic relative-path key to a stub base config and proves the guard goes red - so the guard cannot pass by construction.

proposedFix.regressionTestThatWouldHaveCaught: The new scripts/__tests__/camp01-live-browser-adversarial.test.ts declaration row. At the moment #1544 added `globalSetup: './e2e/globalSetup.ts'` to playwright.config.ts, the guard would have gone red in pr-checks (jest runs on PR; the live workflow does not), naming the unneutralized key - instead of the break landing on main and burning 13 days of the live tier.
rejectedAlternatives: Write the synthetic config INTO the repo root so relative paths keep resolving - breaks the probe's out-of-repo isolation intent and would make globalSetup actually execute against a nonexistent server.
Point globalSetup at an absolute path in the synthetic config - would run the warm-up with webServer:undefined and fail on connection refusal; the probe wants no server.
Delete globalSetup from playwright.config.ts - reverts a real fix for finding #60 (cold-compile inside a measured test) to work around a probe defect. Wrong direction.
proposedFix.residualNotClaimed: This fix is derived from logs and diffs only. Whether the probe then reaches its PROOF-5D5 oracle clean (exitCode 1, complete report, exactly one failed observation, no runtime residue, no partial publication) has NOT been observed in this session - the 13-day outage means no run has exercised the post-config-load path since 33644594559. The parent should treat the first green run as the proof, and be prepared for a second, separately-introduced defect hiding behind this one.
